name: snoopy-automations
description: Autom8x automations — automation logic that calls the platform API; holds no secrets, receives only run-scoped tokens at runtime.

scripts.typecheck: tsc --noEmit -p tsconfig.json && tsc --noEmit -p templates/automation/tsconfig.test.json && npm run typecheck --workspaces --if-present
scripts.verify: npm run format:check && npm run check:docs && npm run map -- --check && node scripts/audit-doc-references.mjs && npm run build && npm run typecheck && npm test && tsx scripts/repo-facts.ts --gate verify
